problem: Restaurants miss about 40 percent of calls and answer email slowly, losing bookings (company claim).
product_category: AI reservation system with voice and email agents

founders.name: Alan Mando
founders.background_notes: Founders met in primary school in Stockholm.

competitors.name: Slang.ai
competitors.what: Voice AI phone agent for restaurants integrating with OpenTable, Resy and Toast

competitors.name: SevenRooms voice AI
competitors.what: Voice AI inside a reservation platform

competitors.name: Loman
competitors.what: Voice AI phone agent for restaurants with OpenTable integration

competitors.name: OpenTable Voice AI
competitors.what: Incumbent voice feature, reported as beta in Dec 2025

technical_complexity.rationale: Voice and email agents plus table allocation are applications of existing models with restaurant system integrations.

defensibility.rationale: Replacing the reservation system creates lock-in, but many competitors offer voice layers.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Incumbents were adding AI layers by 2025 and 2026.

market_need_then: Missed restaurant calls are a known problem and multiple voice vendors serve it in 2026. A Swedish business article reportedly says 59 restaurants are live and 200 under contract (relayed by a search summary, article not opened).

brand_strength.rationale: Name is distinctive but there is no press on the brand beyond directory entries.

outcome_analysis: Elyra is a Spring 2026 company with no outcome yet. Two Stockholm founders sell an AI reservation system and reportedly have dozens of live restaurants, which is early traction in a market where incumbents add voice features. It is described as a full reservation system rather than only a phone layer, which could be a differentiator or a harder sale.
